#+title: habshe-emacs — whole-line-or-region
#+author: A. Shehab (habshehabshe)

Configuration of the external package whole-line-or-region: with no
region active, kill and copy commands (C-w, M-w, comment-dwim, ...)
operate on the current real line instead. Installation is owned by
the package manifest in my-emacs-packages; this module only
configures.

#+begin_src emacs-lisp :tangle "../lisp/my-whole-line-or-region.el"
  ;;; my-whole-line-or-region.el --- GENERATED from org/whole-line-or-region.org — do not edit -*- lexical-binding: t; -*-
  ;;; Commentary: whole-line-or-region: whole-line kill/copy fallback.

  (defgroup my-whole-line-or-region nil
    "whole-line-or-region configuration for my Emacs configuration.")

  ;; Soft require: if the install pass could not run (e.g. no network
  ;; on first boot), init survives without the whole-line fallback
  ;; rather than breaking.
  (when (require 'whole-line-or-region nil t)
    (whole-line-or-region-global-mode 1))

  (provide 'my-whole-line-or-region)
#+end_src
